result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, we-voice framing built around five named core values presented as headlines. Customers and people are placed first, and the Serve and Integrity values are stated in absolute terms. Forward-looking 'will' commitments appear in the Foundation section. Environment is absent. Safety and innovation appear only as passing strategy phrases.
